@noDict.description: The empty state's title, while no dictionary is open.

noDictHint: Open a .rdict file to start browsing

@noDictHint.description: The empty state's hint, under its title.

@openDict.description: The empty state's button, which opens the file picker.

@open.description: The File menu item, which opens the file picker.

@selectWord.description: The detail pane's placeholder, while no word is selected.

@close.description: The dictionary card's context menu item, which removes that dictionary from the shelf.

@related.description: The card listing a word's synonyms, antonyms and derivatives.

@wordStructure.description: The card listing a word's prefixes, roots and suffixes.

@failedToOpen.description: The error alert's message, when a pack fails to open.

@failedToLoadImage.description: Shown in place of a media image that fails to decode.

@language.description: The menu holding the app's languages.

@morphemePrefix.description: A morpheme of a word's structure: a prefix.

@morphemeSuffix.description: A morpheme of a word's structure: a suffix.

@morphemeRoot.description: A morpheme of a word's structure: a root.

@morphemeCombiningForm.description: A morpheme of a word's structure: a combining form.

@morphemeParticle.description: A morpheme of a word's structure: a particle.

@morphemeStem.description: A morpheme of a word's structure: a stem.

@relationSynonym.description: A related word's type: a synonym.

@relationAntonym.description: A related word's type: an antonym.

@relationDerived.description: A related word's type: a derivative.
